purpose: Group image attachments over the library: send encrypts each blob with group.encryptMedia, uploads ONLY the ciphertext to Blossom and sends one kind-9 rumor (through the S6 sender) whose imeta tags are the library's encrypted-media-v1 tags plus a role field; receive parses the imeta with the library codec, fetches the ciphertext by a trusted blossom-v1 locator, decrypts with group.decryptMedia and keeps the plaintext in the app's decrypted cache (few-media-blobs / few-media-meta) so a reload serves it without decrypting again. Built beside the old marmot-ts media path (useImageSend / useDecryptedImage are rewired by S18, the old exports are deleted by S22).

public_api.name: buildGroupImetaTag
public_api.description: The library imeta tag of one EncryptedMedia plus ` role <role>`; throws TypeError unless it is exactly one valid encrypted-media-v1 tag with a blossom-v1 locator (http / unsafe-host / cache-only locators fail here, loudly, before anything is sent).

public_api.name: extractGroupAttachmentsByRole
public_api.signature: (tags: string[][]) => { full: GroupImageAttachment | null; thumb: GroupImageAttachment | null }
public_api.description: Parses imeta tags with the library codec (invalid / legacy tags skipped; missing role = full; first tag per role wins); keeps the original tag for decryptMedia.

public_api.name: groupAttachmentFingerprint
public_api.description: Cache identity of one attachment record; a forged record that differs in any of the four fields is cache-distinct.

public_api.name: createGroupImageService
public_api.signature: (deps: { sender: Pick<GroupRumorSender,'prepare'>; upload(ciphertext): Promise<string>; download(attachment): Promise<Uint8Array>; cache: GroupMediaCachePort; blossomServers: readonly string[]; warn?; maxCiphertextBytes? }) => { sendImage(group, input): Promise<{rumorId; createdAt; full; thumb}>; loadImage(group, ref): Promise<{bytes; type}> }
public_api.description: Send and receive orchestration. Required ports are validated at construction (TypeError).

public_api.name: getAttachmentCiphertext
public_api.description: Tries the attachment's blossom-v1 locators in order, skipping origins off the operator allowlist, accepting only bytes whose SHA-256 equals ciphertextSha256.

public_api.name: blossomMediaPorts
public_api.description: Production wiring of the service's Blossom ports; upload verifies the server stored the blob the locator names.

public_api.name: groupMediaCachePort
public_api.description: The existing few-media-blobs / few-media-meta persistence as the service's cache port.

dependencies_allowed: app/src/lib/marmot/send (GroupRumorSender / SendableGroup types, via its index.ts)
idb-keyval (existing cache stores; update() is not used)
dependencies_forbidden: @internet-privacy/marmot-ts (in NEW code; the pre-existing old exports keep their import until S22)
uploading plaintext, or any bytes other than the library's ciphertext
external_ports: download(attachment) -> ciphertext bytes (Blossom GET by locator)
